B2L05-G01-P122.title: Rewrite the sentences with 被. Then complete the sentences.

repairs.note: The first sentence already uses 把. With 被, the thing that something happens to comes first, then 被 and the one who did it.
With 被, the thing that something happens to comes first; the one who did it comes after 被.

items.fallbackRepair: The juice first, then 被, then who drank it, then the verb: 我的果汁被室友喝了.

result.traditional: 我的果汁被室友喝了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ de guǒzhī bèi shìyǒu hē le.
result.english: My juice was drunk by my roommate.

segments.traditional: 媽媽看見弟弟不寫功課，在玩遊戲。
segments.simplified: 妈妈看见弟弟不写功课，在玩游戏。

segments.traditional: 弟弟不寫功課，在玩遊戲，
segments.simplified: 弟弟不写功课，在玩游戏，

repairs.note: 把 would make Mom the one who was seen. Mom is the one who saw him: 被媽媽看見了.
The first sentence says Mom did see him, so there is no 沒.

items.fallbackRepair: 被, then the one who saw him, then the verb, then 了: 被媽媽看見了.

result.traditional: 弟弟不寫功課，在玩遊戲，被媽媽看見了。
result.simplified: 弟弟不写功课，在玩游戏，被妈妈看见了。
result.pinyin: Dìdi bù xiě gōngkè, zài wán yóuxì, bèi māma kànjiàn le.
result.english: My younger brother wasn't doing his homework and was playing games, and Mom saw him.

segments.traditional: 小狗弄髒了我剛洗乾淨的鞋子。
segments.simplified: 小狗弄脏了我刚洗干净的鞋子。

tiles.pinyin: wǒ gāng xǐ gānjìng de xiézi

repairs.note: 把 puts the one who did it first. With 被, the thing that something happens to comes first, then 被 and the one who did it.
With 被, the thing that something happens to comes first; the one who did it comes after 被.

items.fallbackRepair: The shoes first, then 被, then who did it, then the verb: 我剛洗乾淨的鞋子被小狗弄髒了.

result.traditional: 我剛洗乾淨的鞋子被小狗弄髒了。
result.simplified: 我刚洗干净的鞋子被小狗弄脏了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ gāng xǐ gānjìng de xiézi bèi xiǎogǒu nòngzāng le.
result.english: The shoes I had just washed clean were dirtied by the puppy.

segments.traditional: 弟弟把巧克力都吃完了，可是

repairs.note: This has already happened. Something that did not happen takes 沒, before 被.
把 would make Mom the thing that was found. Mom is the one who could have found out: 被媽媽發現.

items.fallbackRepair: 沒 goes before 被; then the person, then the verb: 沒被媽媽發現.

result.traditional: 弟弟把巧克力都吃完了，可是沒被媽媽發現。
result.simplified: 弟弟把巧克力都吃完了，可是没被妈妈发现。
result.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ qiǎokèlì dōu chīwán le, kěshì méi bèi māma fāxiàn.
result.english: My younger brother ate up all the chocolate, but Mom didn't find out.

segments.traditional: 我找不到我的車，我要去找警察。
segments.simplified: 我找不到我的车，我要去找警察。

repairs.note: The car has not been stolen. Something that did not happen takes 沒, before 被.
把 needs the thing acted on right after it. The car comes first here, so it takes 被.

items.fallbackRepair: 沒 goes before 被, then the verb: 沒被偷.

result.traditional: 你的車停在公園旁邊，沒被偷啊！
result.simplified: 你的车停在公园旁边，没被偷啊！
result.pinyin: Nǐ de chē tíng zài gōngyuán pángbiān, méi bèi tōu a!
result.english: Your car is parked beside the park; it hasn't been stolen!

segments.traditional: 那你去打球的時候得小心一點，不要
segments.simplified: 那你去打球的时候得小心一点，不要

repairs.note: 把 marks the thing that is acted on. Here a person is the one who gets hit, so it takes 被.
The friend's head hurts, so he did get hit. And Mom's warning is 不要被打到: don't get hit.

items.fallbackRepair: 被, then what hit him, then the verb: 被球打到. After 不要 comes 被 again.

result.simplified: 我朋友昨天被球打到，头很疼，所以今天没去上课。那你去打球的时候得小心一点，不要被打到。
result.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu zuótiān bèi qiú dǎdào, tóu hěn téng, suǒyǐ jīntiān méi qù shàngkè. Nà nǐ qù dǎqiú de shíhòu děi xiǎoxīn yìdiǎn, búyào bèi dǎdào.
result.english: My friend was hit by a ball yesterday and has a headache, so he didn't go to class today. / Then be careful when you go to play ball; don't get hit.

segments.traditional: 妹妹在公車上聽音樂，然後就到家了。
segments.simplified: 妹妹在公车上听音乐，然后就到家了。

repairs.note: Something that happens before you notice, in the middle of another action, takes 就.
The action was still going on, so the verb is repeated with 著: 聽著聽著.
She is listening to music: 聽.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb + 著 twice, then 就: 聽著聽著就到家了.

result.traditional: 妹妹在公車上聽音樂，聽著聽著就到家了。
result.simplified: 妹妹在公车上听音乐，听着听着就到家了。
result.pinyin: Mèimei zài gōngchē shàng tīng yīnyuè, tīngzhe tīngzhe jiù dào jiā le.
result.english: My younger sister was listening to music on the bus, and before she knew it she was home.

segments.traditional: 他走路去圖書館，後來下雨了。
segments.simplified: 他走路去图书馆，后来下雨了。

repairs.note: Something that happens in the middle of another action takes 就.
The action was still going on, so the verb is repeated with 著: 走著走著.
He is walking to the library (走路): 走.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb + 著 twice, then 就: 走著走著就下雨了.

result.traditional: 他走路去圖書館，走著走著就下雨了。
result.simplified: 他走路去图书馆，走着走着就下雨了。
result.pinyin: Tā zǒulù qù túshūguǎn, zǒuzhe zǒuzhe jiù xià yǔ le.
result.english: He was walking to the library, and as he walked it started to rain.

segments.traditional: 媽媽說故事給孩子聽，後來孩子睡著了。
segments.simplified: 妈妈说故事给孩子听，后来孩子睡着了。

repairs.note: The first sentence says who fell asleep: the child.
Something that happens in the middle of another action takes 就.

items.fallbackRepair: The verb + 著 twice; then the second person comes before 就: 孩子就睡著了.

result.traditional: 媽媽說故事給孩子聽，說著說著，孩子就睡著了。
result.simplified: 妈妈说故事给孩子听，说着说着，孩子就睡着了。
result.pinyin: Māma shuō gùshì gěi háizi tīng, shuōzhe shuōzhe, háizi jiù shuìzháo le.
result.english: Mom was telling the child a story, and as she talked the child fell asleep.

B2L05-G03-P124.title: Complete the dialogues with the given phrases.

segments.traditional: 我的中文字寫得不好看，怎麼辦？
segments.simplified: 我的中文字写得不好看，怎么办？

repairs.note: 只要 gives one easy condition, and its result takes 就.
Writing gets better with more practice, not less: 多.

items.fallbackRepair: 只要 first; 多 goes before the verb; then 就: 只要多練習就可以了.

result.traditional: 沒關係，只要多練習就可以了。
result.simplified: 没关系，只要多练习就可以了。
result.pinyin: Méiguānxi, zhǐyào duō liànxí jiù kěyǐ le.
result.english: It's all right. As long as you practice more, it will be fine.

segments.traditional: 應該怎麼做，我的身體才會比較健康？
segments.simplified: 应该怎么做，我的身体才会比较健康？

repairs.note: 只要 gives one easy condition, and its result takes 就.
More dessert does not make anyone healthier: 少吃甜點.
Less exercise does not make anyone healthier: 多運動.

items.fallbackRepair: The two healthy habits after 只要你, and 就 before the result.

result.traditional: 只要你少吃甜點、多運動，身體就會比較健康。
result.simplified: 只要你少吃甜点、多运动，身体就会比较健康。
result.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō yùndòng, shēntǐ jiù huì bǐjiào jiànkāng.
result.english: As long as you eat fewer desserts and exercise more, your body will be healthier.

alternatives.traditional: 只要你多運動、少吃甜點，身體就會比較健康。
alternatives.simplified: 只要你多运动、少吃甜点，身体就会比较健康。
alternatives.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, shēntǐ jiù huì bǐjiào jiànkāng.
alternatives.english: As long as you exercise more and eat fewer desserts, your body will be healthier.

segments.traditional: 我可以躺在公園的草地上嗎？
segments.simplified: 我可以躺在公园的草地上吗？

repairs.note: 只要 gives one easy condition, and its result takes 就.

items.fallbackRepair: 只要 opens the condition (no trash and no bugs on the grass); 就 comes before 可以.

result.traditional: 只要草地上沒有垃圾和蟲子，就可以。
result.simplified: 只要草地上没有垃圾和虫子，就可以。
result.pinyin: Zhǐyào cǎodì shàng méiyǒu lèsè hé chóngzi, jiù kěyǐ.
result.english: As long as there is no trash and there are no bugs on the grass, you can.

alternatives.traditional: 草地上只要沒有垃圾和蟲子，就可以。
alternatives.simplified: 草地上只要没有垃圾和虫子，就可以。
alternatives.pinyin: Cǎodì shàng zhǐyào méiyǒu lèsè hé chóngzi, jiù kěyǐ.
alternatives.english: As long as there is no trash and there are no bugs on the grass, you can.

segments.traditional: 你每天下班以後，都在家做什麼？
segments.simplified: 你每天下班以后，都在家做什么？

repairs.note: 一邊 comes in pairs and means two things done at the same moment. Things done at different times take 有時候…，有時候….
A asks what B does at home. A night market is not at home.

items.fallbackRepair: 有時候 before each of the two activities.

result.traditional: 有時候看電視，有時候上網。
result.simplified: 有时候看电视，有时候上网。
result.pinyin: Yǒushíhòu kàn diànshì, yǒushíhòu shàngwǎng.
result.english: Sometimes I watch television, and sometimes I go online.

alternatives.traditional: 有時候上網，有時候看電視。
alternatives.simplified: 有时候上网，有时候看电视。
alternatives.english: Sometimes I go online, and sometimes I watch television.

segments.traditional: 你姐姐喜歡買什麼顏色的衣服？
segments.simplified: 你姐姐喜欢买什么颜色的衣服？

repairs.note: 一邊 comes in pairs and means two things done at the same moment. Things done at different times take 有時候…，有時候….
A asks about colors. 大的 is a size.

items.fallbackRepair: 有時候 before each 買, and a color after each.

result.traditional: 她有時候買紅色的，有時候買白色的。
result.simplified: 她有时候买红色的，有时候买白色的。
result.pinyin: Tā yǒushíhòu mǎi hóngsè de, yǒushíhòu mǎi báisè de.
result.english: Sometimes she buys red ones, and sometimes she buys white ones.

alternatives.traditional: 她有時候買白色的，有時候買紅色的。
alternatives.simplified: 她有时候买白色的，有时候买红色的。
alternatives.pinyin: Tā yǒushíhòu mǎi báisè de, yǒushíhòu mǎi hóngsè de.
alternatives.english: Sometimes she buys white ones, and sometimes she buys red ones.

segments.traditional: 這個社區的人，有空的時候會做什麼？
segments.simplified: 这个社区的人，有空的时候会做什么？

repairs.note: People swim in a pool (游泳池), not on a lawn or a ball court.
一邊 comes in pairs and means two things done at the same moment. Things done at different times take 有時候…，有時候….

items.fallbackRepair: 有時候 before each place; a picnic goes with the lawn, and ball games with the ball court.

result.traditional: 他們有時候在草地上野餐，有時候去球場打球。
result.simplified: 他们有时候在草地上野餐，有时候去球场打球。

segments.traditional: 山本良介害羞的時候，臉就

segments.traditional: 還不到中午吃飯的時間，妳怎麼
segments.simplified: 还不到中午吃饭的时间，你怎么

segments.simplified: 我早上很忙，没时间吃东西。

repairs.note: An action that begins takes 起…來, never 起…去.

items.fallbackRepair: The thing eaten goes between 起 and 來: 吃起飯來.

result.english: It isn't even lunchtime yet. How come you have started eating?

segments.traditional: 是啊！早上天氣不錯，沒想到下午就
segments.simplified: 是啊！早上天气不错，没想到下午就

repairs.note: An action that begins takes 起…來, never 起…去.

items.fallbackRepair: 雨 goes between 起 and 來: 下起雨來.

result.traditional: 是啊！早上天氣不錯，沒想到下午就下起雨來了。
result.simplified: 是啊！早上天气不错，没想到下午就下起雨来了。

result.english: Yes! The weather was nice in the morning; I didn't expect it to start raining in the afternoon.

segments.traditional: 你看，今天排隊買電影票的人真多！
segments.simplified: 你看，今天排队买电影票的人真多！

repairs.note: They can still get tickets, so the lucky thing is that they came early.

雖然 sets up a contrast ("although"). Coming early is the lucky thing, and that opens with 還好.

repairs.note: 可是 would mean the thieves come anyway. What would happen without the guards takes 要不然 ("otherwise").

items.fallbackRepair: 要不然 first, then who, then 會: 要不然小偷會來偷東西.

segments.traditional: 你的獎學金一個月兩萬塊，夠嗎？

items.fallbackRepair: The lucky thing after 還好; then 要不然, then 就 before 不夠.

result.simplified: 还好房租不贵，要不然就不够了。

result.english: Luckily the rent isn't expensive; otherwise it wouldn't be enough.

segments.traditional: 張先生一個禮拜打一次網球。
segments.simplified: 张先生一个礼拜打一次网球。

repairs.note: 第 would make it "the first week". "Every week" is 每.

segments.simplified: 他家的浴室很干净，因为星期二、四、六都要打扫。

segments.simplified: 他家的浴室很干净，因为

segments.traditional: 醫生說，看三十分鐘的書，就應該休息一下。
segments.simplified: 医生说，看三十分钟的书，就应该休息一下。

segments.traditional: 林小姐說話的聲音很溫柔，
segments.simplified: 林小姐说话的声音很温柔，
